description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them to git.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit. Read-only.
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every vault change and commit it

Flags:
  review:
    --max-file-lines N   max diff lines shown per file (default 150)
    --max-lines N        max lines of output overall (default 3000)
  save:
    --message SUBJECT    required. One line, non-empty.
    --body TEXT          commit body; may span multiple lines
    --dry-run            report what would be staged and committed; change nothing

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB meeting and flush buffer", "--body", "Added kickoff note, 3h on Projects/SGB, two new tasks."]
  ["save", "--message", "Record SGB payment", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run review first, then save with a summary that matches what review showed.
  save stages everything in the vault. It only ever adds a commit: it never amends, resets or pushes.
  Exit 1: empty or multi-line --message, the vault is not a git repository or not the root of its repository, or a git command failed.
